Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

package Problems_On_String;

public class RemoveDuplicates {
    public static String removeDuplicateLetters(String s) {

        String ans = "";
        boolean[] map = new boolean[26];
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            if (map[s.charAt(i) - 'a'] == false) {
                ans += s.charAt(i);
                map[s.charAt(i) - 'a'] = true;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        String str = "cbacdcbc";
        System.out.println("Original String: " + str + " After removing duplicates: " + removeDuplicateLetters(str));

    }
}
